text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both slightly down on the day despite elevated greed readings, suggesting sentiment remains constructive even as prices consolidate. Bitcoin's dominance at 59.1% with $75B in daily volume indicates steady conviction in the larger cap assets rather than risk-off rotation. The Fear & Greed index climbing 9 points over a week signals confidence is building, though modest daily declines across the board hint at profit-taking or consolidation before the next directional move.
